newsitem.title: USA: Unemployment rate drops to 3.6 percent in Missouri.
newsitem.headline: Unemployment rate drops to 3.6 percent in Missouri.

text.p: Missouri's unemployment rate fell to 3.5 percent in October, while the number of jobless workers hit its lowest point in 17 years, the state's department of labor and industrial relations reported Thursday.

According to the department, there were 100,000 unemployed workers in October, compared to 101,600 in September, when the jobless rate was 3.6 percent. The October jobless number was the lowest in Missouri since October 1979, when the number of unemployed was estimated at 92,825, the department added.
